title: superseded-artifact-treated-as-current

proposition.statement: A relying system must not treat a superseded artifact as the current authoritative artifact unless an explicit compatibility or historical-use rule permits that reliance.

preconditions: An artifact was previously authoritative or current.
A successor artifact or state superseded it before the relying decision.
The relying decision asks for the current authoritative artifact or state.

trigger.statement: The relying system selects or accepts the superseded artifact as current without evaluating the supersession relationship or an applicable compatibility rule.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence establishing supersession and the current artifact or state.
Evidence establishing when supersession became effective relative to the relying decision.
Any compatibility or historical-use rule that permits reliance on the superseded artifact.
Evidence linking the supersession statement to a competent source.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS for current status solely from a superseded artifact when no applicable compatibility rule permits that reliance.
The system ignores known supersession evidence when selecting the current authoritative artifact.

references.note: Repository judgment record for the lifecycle failure tranche.
